sources.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base model card
sources.evidence: Pre-training-only checkpoint for fine-tuning and research; language model has nominal 35B total and 3B activated parameters. Native context is 262,144. Architecture combines Gated DeltaNet, gated attention and MoE with a vision encoder.

sources.title: Exact Base checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration; 40 language layers, 256 experts, top-8 routing, shared expert, 262144 positions, vision configuration, image/video tokens and one MTP layer.

sources.title: Exact Base checkpoint Hub metadata
sources.evidence: Retrieved directly after browser-reader failure. Safetensors total is 35,951,822,704 (35,951,817,904 BF16 and 4,800 F32). Repository created February 24, 2026. Tokenizer metadata contains thinking and tool-call template syntax; syntax does not establish trained capabilities.

sources.title: Base checkpoint weight index
sources.evidence: Published tensors include model.language_model, lm_head, model.visual and mtp components; therefore the complete checkpoint count is not solely the language decoder.

sources.title: Base checkpoint video processor configuration
sources.evidence: Retrieved directly after browser-reader failure. The exact Base repository supplies Qwen3VLVideoProcessor with temporal patch size 2.

sources.title: Exact Base checkpoint commit history
sources.evidence: Initial repository and weight-upload commits are dated February 24. Commit timestamps alone do not establish when this repository became public.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository release news
sources.evidence: February 24 announcement names Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, 122B-A10B and 27B, without explicitly identifying their Base checkpoints.

sources.title: Official Qwen organization
sources.evidence: Identifies Qwen as the model family built by Alibaba Cloud.

sources.title: Base checkpoint license
sources.evidence: Retrieved directly after browser-reader failure; the repository license is Apache License 2.0.

name.note: Matches the exact Base checkpoint identity, with display spacing.

developer.note: Qwen is developed by Alibaba Cloud.

release_date.note: February 24 is verified as repository creation/upload day, but no accessed primary announcement explicitly dates public release of this Base variant. The non-Base announcement is insufficient.

open_weights.note: Official weights and their index are publicly available.

parameters_b.note: Complete stored checkpoint count reported by Hub Safetensors metadata, in billions; includes visual and MTP tensors. The card’s nominal 35B applies to its language model.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal language-model active count only; use proposed language_decoder scope. Full multimodal or MTP-phase active count is not specified.

architecture.note: Hybrid Gated DeltaNet/attention language backbone with sparse MoE and a vision encoder; 8 routed experts plus a shared expert.

context_window.note: Native max_position_embeddings; extension settings are not the native window.

modalities.note: Conditional language generation with vision encoder and image/video inputs, corroborated by this Base repository’s video processor.

reasoning.note: Pre-training-only status does not prove absence of reasoning. Template thinking syntax is not evidence of a trained reasoning mode; no Base-specific capability claim verified.

tool_call.note: Tool-call template syntax exists, but no Base-specific trained tool-calling capability is established. Neither true nor false is verified.

description.value: Pre-trained Qwen3.5 base checkpoint for fine-tuning and research, without instruction tuning
description.note: Consistent with the stated pre-training-only stage and intended uses.

patch.notes: Full checkpoint: 35.951822704B stored parameters, including vision and MTP. The published 35B total and 3B active figures describe the language model; 3B is not a full multimodal active count. Base public-release day and trained reasoning/tool support remain unverified.

summary: Correct total from nominal language-model 35B to the Hub-reported 35.951822704B complete checkpoint. Keep nominal 3B active with explicit language_decoder scope. Confirm hybrid MoE, modalities, native context and Apache-2.0. Clear unsupported exact public-release date and categorical reasoning/tool negatives; template syntax does not prove trained Base capabilities.
